items.t: A 67-Year-Old With $750,000 in Pfizer, Altria and Realty Income Collects $3,575 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Pfizer, Altria and Realty Income pays $42,905 a year in dividends at current prices, or $3,594 a month. Altria and Realty Income cover their dividends with room to spare, at 78% of free cash flow and 75% of AFFO.

items.t: $500,000 in Realty Income and NNN REIT: How Much More You Keep in a Roth IRA
items.sum: Monthly checks from Realty Income and NNN REIT look like easy income until tax season. Because of how REIT payouts are classified, the same portfolio can leave very different amounts in your pocket depending on the account that holds it.
